name: Lelystad
_note: Frequencies per current AIP listing. Circuits per AIP: 05 left-hand, 23 right-hand, same footprint for the 500 ft AMSL training circuit and the 1000 ft AMSL standard circuit. 'circuit' values measured from the VAC; see profiles/README.md.
notes: AIP EHLE: circuits are RWY 05 left-hand and RWY 23 right-hand (fixed, entry/exit routes never change).
AIP: standard circuit altitude 1000 ft AMSL (inbound VFR); VFR training circuit is 500 ft AMSL. Orange ground markers are the turning points downwind/base and base/final.
VAC note: only turn base after receiving a number in the sequence and the traffic to follow.

circuit._note: Measured from the VAC (training circuit loops), scaled with the 2700 m runway; approx +-10%. Downwind offset 0.53 NM, turn radius ~0.26 NM, loop starts 0.38 NM before the approach threshold.
